# Example of a High-Quality Prompt

“You are a gritty crime novelist. The story takes place in a corrupt city where law enforcement is compromised. The main character is a detective who is slowly losing faith in justice. Write a scene where he confronts a suspect who may be innocent. Use sharp dialogue and avoid exposition.”

Now compare that to “write a crime story.”

One gives direction.One gives confusion.

Adjust prompts mid-story.

# Prompt Templates You Can Use

“You are [role]. The setting is [world]. The main character is [description]. The conflict is [problem]. Write in [style].”

“You are [role]. The story takes place in [detailed setting]. The protagonist is [complex character]. Their goal is [goal], but they face [conflict]. Maintain [tone]. Avoid [undesired behavior].”

# Conclusion

Character AI storytelling is not about randomness.

It’s about control.

The better your framework, the better your story.

And if you’re still typing “write me something cool”… well, the AI is doing exactly what you asked.

Which is not much.
